units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data ../magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_1/nvt_equilibrated.data

# EAM potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * ../magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_1/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300 12345

# NPT equilibration
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
timestep 0.001

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run NPT
run 10000

# Write final structure
write_data npt_equilibrated.data
"}
